unbounded_support_certificate_example.scope: Closed-form exact capability example. The sample-size bound is theoretical, not an empirical certificate or registered experiment.

terminal_clock_compiler.scope: Stationary IID active-step kernel, no wait information/idle costs/early termination, policy uses active local history and clock only. Does not optimize episode length or dominate all global-clock policies.

no_edge_assumption_counterexample.explanation: Positive predictable gross drift; no default payout. Early placement strictly beats late, violating no-edge dominance.

scope: Finite library evaluation by trajectory enumeration, not Bellman dynamic programming or an optimal policy claim.
The examples were constructed after seeing the manuscript and are not new empirical confirmation.
ABSTAIN means no positive harmful witness in this library, except that full booking and the stated high-capital bound have analytic class-wide no-edge guarantees.
Martingale subtraction can increase variance; the first benchmark explicitly exhibits this failure.
No market data, learner training, protected artifact or Study R outcome was read.
